bss.topic: Revisão do 1º período: eu, minha família e meu país

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em uma linha do tempo, o que vem primeiro?
questions.hint: Pense no que acontece logo no começo da vida.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Uma linha do tempo serve para mostrar…
options: a ordem em que as coisas aconteceram
questions.answer: a ordem em que as coisas aconteceram
questions.hint: Pense em antes e depois.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Lia aprendeu a andar com 1 ano e começou a ler com 6 anos. O que aconteceu antes?
questions.hint: Compare os números: qual é menor?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em uma árvore genealógica, a mãe do seu pai é sua…
questions.hint: Ela também é mãe de alguém da sua família.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O filho do seu tio é seu…
questions.hint: É alguém da sua idade, mais ou menos, de outra casa da família.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Na árvore genealógica, quem aparece na mesma linha que você?
questions.hint: Quem é da mesma geração que você?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destas fotos é a mais antiga?
options: Foto do seu aniversário de 6 anos
questions.hint: Quem nasceu primeiro na família?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é um símbolo nacional do Brasil?
questions.hint: É usado para representar o país inteiro.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual frase está escrita na bandeira do Brasil?
questions.hint: São três palavras na faixa branca.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual cor NÃO aparece na bandeira do Brasil?
questions.hint: Lembre da bandeira: o retângulo, o losango e o círculo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que aparece dentro do círculo azul da bandeira?
questions.hint: Lembre do céu à noite.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A música que representa o Brasil se chama…
questions.hint: Cantamos em eventos importantes, em pé.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que dia comemoramos a Independência do Brasil? (dia e mês)
questions.hint: É no mês 9 do ano.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano o Brasil ficou independente?
questions.hint: Foi há pouco mais de 200 anos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A Independência quer dizer que o Brasil…
options: deixou de ser governado por Portugal
questions.answer: deixou de ser governado por Portugal
questions.hint: Antes, outro país mandava aqui.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Conte uma coisa que você aprendeu sobre sua família neste período.
questions.hint: Pense em uma foto, uma história ou alguém da árvore genealógica.

en.topic: Review: sentence types, conjunctions and noun phrases

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What kind of sentence is this? 'Close the door.'
questions.hint: Is someone being told to do something?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What kind of sentence is this? 'Where is my hat?'
questions.hint: Look at the punctuation at the end.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What kind of sentence is this? 'The cat is asleep.'
questions.hint: Does it simply tell you a fact?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What kind of sentence is this? 'What a huge cake!'
questions.hint: It starts with 'What' but is not asking anything.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is a question?
questions.hint: Which one wants an answer?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which punctuation mark ends a question?
questions.hint: It has a curly top and a dot.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'I like apples ___ I like pears.'
questions.hint: You are joining two things you like.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'I wanted to play, ___ it was raining.'
questions.hint: The second part stops the first from happening.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'Do you want milk ___ juice?'
questions.hint: You are offering a choice.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'I wore my coat ___ it was cold.'
questions.hint: The second part gives a reason.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'You can go out ___ you finish your lunch.'
questions.hint: It depends on something happening first.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best word: 'We sang a song ___ we waited for the bus.'
questions.hint: Two things happen at the same time.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is an expanded noun phrase?
questions.hint: Look for describing words before the noun.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which adjective best fits? 'a ___ lion'
questions.hint: You need a describing word for a noun.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In 'the tall green tree', which word is the noun?
questions.hint: Which word names a thing?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write a statement about your favourite toy using two adjectives.
questions.hint: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

en_read.topic: Review: classic stories, poems and non-fiction from Term 1

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word tells you what happened first?
questions.hint: Look for the word that starts a story.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word is best for the end of a story?
questions.hint: Which word tells you there is no more to come?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Put these in order: (A) Sam ate the cake. (B) Sam baked a cake. (C) Sam bought eggs. Which comes first?
questions.hint: What do you need before you can bake?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Put these in order: (A) The egg hatched. (B) The hen laid an egg. (C) The chick grew. Which comes last?
questions.hint: Think about how a chick grows up.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: When you retell a story, you should…
options: tell what happened in the right order
questions.answer: tell what happened in the right order
questions.hint: Think about the beginning, middle and end.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What do we call the people or animals in a story?
questions.hint: They are the 'who' of the story.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is the setting of a story?
questions.hint: Think about the place in the story.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which pair of words rhymes?
questions.hint: Listen to the ends of the words.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which word rhymes with 'moon'? spoon, map, leaf
questions.hint: Say each word and listen to the ending.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Twinkle, little star, / shining near and shining far.' Which two words rhyme?
questions.hint: Look at the last word of each line.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: A book that gives true facts is called…
questions.hint: It is the opposite of made-up stories.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Where would you look to find which page a topic is on?
questions.hint: It is near the front of a non-fiction book.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: A glossary in a non-fiction book tells you…
questions.hint: It is like a small dictionary.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Mia's lip wobbled and she looked at her broken kite.' How does Mia feel?
questions.hint: What does a wobbling lip often show?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Read: 'Ben jumped up and down and cheered when he saw the snow.' How does Ben feel?
questions.hint: Think about why people cheer.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What is your favourite story from this term? Say why you like it.
questions.hint: Think about a character or a part that made you smile.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: bri_ _e (something that goes over a river)
questions.hint: The sound at the end is spelled with three letters: one of them is silent.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.hint: The letter g can make a 'j' sound before i.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letter and write the whole word: _nock (to tap on a door)
questions.hint: This word starts with a silent letter.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Write the plural of 'fly'.
questions.hint: Change the y to i first.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Add -er to 'happy' and write the new word.
questions.hint: Change the y to i before adding the ending.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has a silent letter?
questions.hint: Say each word: which has a letter you cannot hear?

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: In which word does c make an 's' sound?
questions.hint: Look at the letter after the c.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Write the plural of 'baby'.
questions.hint: It ends in y, just like 'fly'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Fill in the missing letters and write the whole word: hed_ _ _ (a row of bushes)
questions.hint: It ends like 'bridge'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: brige → bridge; sity → city; bottel → bottle; becos → because; flys → flies
questions.hint: Check the words you learnt this term: endings, soft c and y to i.
questions.text: We walked across the old brige to the big sity. A tall man was selling lemonade in a glass bottel. My little brother said he was hungry becos he had skipped lunch. Two flys buzzed around his ice cream, but he still smiled and said it was the best day ever.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct for a busy place with lots of buildings and people?
questions.hint: The letter c can make an 's' sound before i.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct for putting words on paper with a pencil?
questions.hint: There is a silent letter at the start.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct for something you drink water from?
questions.hint: This ending is the most common one: -le.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct for a long hole that trains go through?
questions.hint: After n, this word uses -el.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling is correct? 'I stayed in ___ I was ill.'
questions.hint: It ends with 'cause'.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which word has the same silent letter at the start as 'knock'?
questions.hint: Which word starts with k but you cannot hear it?

ipc.topic: Review: Buildings and From A to B units

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which material is best for making a window?
questions.hint: Think about which material you can see through.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which material is waterproof?
questions.hint: Which one keeps water out?

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which of these materials is strong enough to build the walls of a house?
questions.hint: Walls must hold up the roof.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: In the story of the three little pigs, which material did the house that did not blow down use? (one word)
questions.hint: It is hard and heavy.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which shape is often used to make a bridge or roof strong?
questions.hint: Look at the shape of many roofs.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which material is natural?
questions.hint: It comes from a tree.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: A boat is made of a material that floats. What happens to a stone dropped in water?
questions.hint: Stones are heavy for their size.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which of these will float in water?
questions.hint: It is very light for its size.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which transport travels on rails?
questions.hint: Think of a station with tracks.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which transport travels on water?
questions.hint: It carries people across rivers and seas.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which transport flies in the air?
questions.hint: It takes off from an airport.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: On a map, what do we call the small pictures or symbols that are explained in a box called a ___? (one word)
questions.hint: It helps you unlock what the symbols mean.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: On a compass, which direction is opposite to north?
questions.hint: Think of the bottom of a map.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: A map of your classroom drawn from above is called a ___.
questions.hint: Imagine looking down like a flying bird.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Choose one material and explain why it would be good for making a raincoat.
questions.hint: Think about what a raincoat must do.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Describe the best way to travel from your home to school and say why.
questions.hint: Think about distance, speed and safety.

math.topic: Review: place value, addition, subtraction and money

questions.subject: math
questions.q: What is the value of the digit 4 in 47?
questions.hint: The 4 is in the tens place.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which number has 6 tens and 3 ones?
questions.hint: Tens come first, then ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which sign makes this true? 58 ___ 85
questions.hint: Compare the tens first.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which list is in order from smallest to largest?
questions.hint: Look at the tens digits.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: What is 10 more than 67?
questions.hint: Only the tens digit changes.

questions.subject: math
questions.hint: Add the ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.hint: 4 tens and 3 tens.

questions.subject: math
questions.hint: Take away from the ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.hint: Add the tens, then the ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.hint: Subtract the tens, then the ones.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Find the missing number: 9 + ___ = 20
questions.hint: Count on from 9 to 20.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Mia has 47 stickers. She gives away 20. How many stickers does she have left?
questions.hint: Take away 2 tens.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: A pencil costs 35p and a rubber costs 20p. How much do they cost altogether, in pence?
questions.hint: Add the two prices.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Tom pays with a £1 coin (100p) for a drink that costs 60p. How much change does he get, in pence?
questions.hint: Count on from 60 to 100.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Which coins make 50p?
questions.hint: Add each set of coins.

questions.subject: math
questions.q: Leo has 3 coins: 20p, 10p and 5p. How much money does he have, in pence?
questions.hint: Start with the biggest coin.

pt.topic: Revisão do 1º período: frases, pontuação e gêneros do dia a dia

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual nome deve ser escrito com letra maiúscula?
questions.hint: Nome de pessoa começa com maiúscula.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Que sinal fica no fim de uma pergunta?
questions.hint: Pense em: Você quer brincar

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Que sinal combina com esta frase de susto: Que medo___
questions.hint: É uma frase de emoção.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual frase termina com o sinal correto?
questions.hint: A frase conta uma informação.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Escreva com letra maiúscula, do jeito certo, o nome da cidade: são paulo
questions.hint: Nome de cidade começa com maiúscula em cada palavra.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual sinal separa os itens desta frase? Comprei pão___ leite e queijo.
questions.hint: É o sinal que dá uma pausa curta.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual é o texto curto que usamos para deixar um recado para alguém?
questions.hint: Pode ficar preso na geladeira.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual texto usamos para chamar alguém para uma festa?
questions.hint: Ele chama as pessoas para vir.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: O que NÃO pode faltar num convite de aniversário?
options: dia, hora e lugar da festa
questions.answer: dia, hora e lugar da festa
questions.hint: Os convidados precisam saber quando e onde ir.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Como as palavras aparecem numa lista de compras?
questions.hint: Pense em como fica fácil de ler no mercado.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Em um bilhete, onde costuma aparecer o nome de quem escreveu?
questions.hint: É como uma assinatura.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Leia o bilhete: "Pedro, fui à padaria. Volto logo. Beijos, mamãe." Quem escreveu o bilhete?
questions.hint: Veja quem assina no fim.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Leia o bilhete: "Pedro, fui à padaria. Volto logo. Beijos, mamãe." Para onde a mamãe foi?
questions.hint: Procure o lugar no bilhete.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Escreva um bilhete curto para um amigo, avisando que você vai levar um jogo para o recreio.
questions.hint: Não esqueça para quem é e quem escreve.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Escreva uma lista com 4 coisas que você levaria para um piquenique.
questions.hint: Coloque uma palavra embaixo da outra.

questions.subject: pt
questions.q: Qual palavra da frase deve começar com letra maiúscula? "ontem choveu muito."
questions.hint: Toda frase começa com maiúscula.

pt_leit.topic: Revisão do 1º período: estratégias de leitura

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Antes de ler um livro, olhamos a capa e o título para ___.
options: imaginar sobre o que é a história
questions.answer: imaginar sobre o que é a história
questions.hint: Isso se chama antecipar.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Um livro se chama "O Cachorro que Queria Voar". Sobre o que deve ser a história?
options: um cachorro que sonha em voar
questions.answer: um cachorro que sonha em voar
questions.hint: Use as palavras do título.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Quando procuramos uma informação que está escrita no texto, estamos ___.
questions.hint: A resposta está lá, é só achar.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Quando descobrimos algo que o texto não diz com todas as letras, estamos ___.
questions.hint: Usamos pistas do texto.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "Caio pegou o guarda-chuva antes de sair." O que podemos inferir?
options: que estava chovendo ou ia chover
questions.answer: que estava chovendo ou ia chover
questions.hint: Para que serve um guarda-chuva?

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "Lara bocejou e esfregou os olhos." Como Lara estava?
questions.hint: O que fazemos quando estamos cansados?

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "O sorvete derreteu rapidinho na mão de Davi." Como estava o dia?
questions.hint: O que faz o sorvete derreter?

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "A gata Mimi dormia na cesta azul." Qual é o nome da gata?
questions.hint: Procure o nome no texto.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia: "A gata Mimi dormia na cesta azul." Onde a gata dormia?
questions.hint: Localize o lugar no texto.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia o conto: "Júlia plantou uma semente no vaso. Todo dia ela regava. Depois de muitos dias, nasceu uma flor amarela." O que Júlia plantou?
questions.hint: Releia a primeira frase.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: No mesmo conto, o que Júlia fazia todo dia?
questions.hint: Procure "todo dia".

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: No mesmo conto, de que cor era a flor que nasceu?
questions.hint: Releia a última frase.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: No mesmo conto, o que a história nos ensina?
options: que cuidar faz as coisas crescerem
que plantas não precisam de água
que flores nascem num dia só
questions.answer: que cuidar faz as coisas crescerem
questions.hint: Pense no que Júlia fez todo dia.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Leia o conto: "Gui achou um cachorrinho molhado na chuva. Levou para casa, secou com a toalha e deu leite." Como Gui é?
questions.hint: Veja o que ele fez pelo cachorrinho.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: No conto do Gui, o que você acha que vai acontecer depois com o cachorrinho? Por quê?
questions.hint: Use as pistas do texto.

questions.subject: pt_leit
questions.q: Conte uma estratégia que ajuda você a entender melhor uma história.
questions.hint: Pense em antecipar, localizar ou inferir.
